style: the labor hangar of a police special vehicles unit on reclaimed land in Tokyo Bay, as in Patlabor: The Movie (1989), well used but kept in order: a muted palette of grey-green, teal and pale blue-grey, with off-white and dull orange machinery and small accents of yellow-and-black hazard stripes and red; a pale grey-green painted concrete floor, scuffed, with a few oil stains, tyre marks and faded painted lines; ribbed steel wall panels in dull teal-grey, a little faded; grey-green painted steelwork; outside, massive blocks of pale grey cast concrete with formwork joints, dark water streaks under the copings, big stencilled numbers and chipped corners
floorStyle: a painted concrete hangar floor: pale grey-green, scuffed, with a few oil stains, tyre marks and faded painted lines

setting.place: Patlabor: The Movie (1989) and its sequel, the animated films this scene is built after
setting.carriers: Walls, concrete blocks, machines, vehicles and cabinets
setting.details: panel seams, formwork joints, rivets, hatches, vents, grilles, stencilled numbers and hazard stripes
setting.materials: painted steel panels, cast concrete, painted concrete or bare steel
setting.fill: carrying on its panels, seams and joints at the same size, with nothing new set against it
setting.light: soft, even indoor light with no cast shadows and no sunlit patches
setting.title: 『機動警察パトレイバー the Movie』
